Distances between stops are great-circle with a road factor, not a routed measurement - the pipeline replaces them when it routes this line.
places-abrigo-del-canto-blanco-los-grajo.story: From Jumilla it runs 165 km to Jumilla; allow about 2 h 51 of riding. The stops in between: Los Grajos I, Cejo Cortado I, Los Grajos and back through Cejo Cortado I. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
